## Skill checklist

- [ ] Changes stay scoped to one skill under `skills/<name>/` (or shared docs when appropriate)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter follows [agentskills.io/specification](https://agentskills.io/specification)
- [ ] Ran `python skills/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py skills/<name>` (or `validate_all.py`)
- [ ] Updated [docs/available-skills.md](../docs/available-skills.md) if the skill was added, removed, or repositioned
- [ ] Added or updated tests when changing non-trivial scripts
